transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I suppose I'm here because... I just feel like things have gone very quiet lately. 

The part of me that used to, I don't know, reach out to people or... take pleasure in things. My work, yoga, going to galleries... even just journaling. It's... it's just gone quiet. I’m mostly just... moving through my obligations right now. That's all.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... about eight months, I think. It started around the time we... well, we took an older relative into our apartment. That's when this whole change in how I'm thinking and... working, and connecting with people really began.
Do you still enjoy the activities you mentioned, such as yoga and going to galleries, even if you're not taking as much pleasure in them as you used to?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't... I haven't been doing them much lately, so... I don't really know.
Do you feel like you're still capable of experiencing pleasure when you do engage in these activities, even if it's just for a moment?
Um... I don't really know. It's... it's hard to say. I just haven't noticed feeling much of anything, to be honest.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself or wishing you weren't alive?
No, I... I haven't had any thoughts like that.
Have you ever felt this way before, like things have gone quiet and you've lost interest in activities, at any other point in your life?
Um... no, I don't think so. I don't really remember feeling quite like this before. It's just... recently, I guess.
Do you feel like you have less energy than you used to?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't noticed being more tired or anything. My energy is probably... fine, I guess. I just haven't been doing much.
Has your appetite changed over the past eight months?
I don't think so. I... I eat about the same, I suppose. Nothing's really changed there.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep over the past eight months?
Um... no. Sleep is... it's just normal, I guess. I haven't really noticed anything different.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or making decisions over the past eight months?
No, not really. I mean... my focus is okay, I think. I just... I make decisions fine when I have to.
Would you say that this quietness and lack of interest in activities is mild, moderate, or severe?

Mild, I think. Um... but it is what finally brought me in. I just... I feel like the part of me that used to reach out for people... or take pleasure in my work, or yoga... galleries... even journaling... it’s just gone very quiet. I’m mostly just... moving through obligations now.
How much of your daily life would you say is affected by this quietness and lack of interest in activities?

Um... well, I'm still showing up to work. But... I guess it affects a fair amount. I've missed some grant deadlines lately. And... my supervisor actually quietly moved some of my more demanding clients to other clinicians. I'm just... not functioning at my usual level, I suppose.
Have you experienced a significant loss of interest in activities you once enjoyed for most of every day?
I don't know if it's... most of every day. I haven't really tracked it like that. It's just... mostly how things are right now, I guess. I don't really think about it.
For how long have you had a decreased interest in the activities you used to enjoy?

Um... about eight months, I think. It... well, it started around the time we took an older relative into our apartment. That's when this whole change with... how I work, and connect with people... kind of began. So, yeah... about eight months.
Would you say that your lack of interest in activities and quietness is causing significant distress or impairment in your daily life?

Um... I guess so. Like I said before... I'm still going to work. But... I missed those grant deadlines. And... my supervisor did move those demanding clients to other people. So... yeah, I suppose I'm just not... functioning like I usually do.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time over the past eight months?
Um... no, I don't think so. I wouldn't say I feel sad. I just... I don't really pay much attention to it, honestly. Things just are what they are.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the time over the past eight months?
No... I don't think I'm depressed. Just... like I said, not really feeling much of anything.
Would you say that your lack of interest in activities and quietness is interfering with your relationships with family and friends?

Um... I don't really know. I haven't been paying much attention to that. Like I was saying earlier... it's mostly at work where I notice it. I'm still showing up, but... missing those grant deadlines, and my supervisor having to quietly move my more demanding clients to other clinicians... I'm just not functioning at my usual level.
Would you describe your current experience as feeling somewhat down or would it be more accurate to say you're feeling down most of the time?
Um... neither, really. I wouldn't say I feel down at all. Just... kind of blank, like I mentioned before. I'm not sad.
